note: Wave O8 (topic 0.23 STRESS_13 item 2.3; the author asked to search for a lab system). Cavity optomechanics has the portal form x |a|^2 with a measurable coupling g0. Its dynamical backaction is the layer-2 friction (red detuning) and the layer-3 capture (blue detuning) of the same coupling, and the parametric-instability threshold is the layer-3 R* = 1/(a tau). The single coupling forces Gamma_opt(-Delta) = -Gamma_opt(+Delta), so the red-side cooling rate predicts the blue-side threshold with no free parameter. Lane choice (x = psi, a = chi) is an AI choice; standard optomechanics gives the same relations (Aspelmeyer, Kippenberg & Marquardt 2014; Khurgin et al. 2012), so this is not UET-distinct. No data opened; a Test Card needs a device with both the cooling rate and the threshold measured (data shape not yet checked).
